note: Round-35 macro fixes: an integer bound wider than i128 on a type alias is range-checked like a fractional one (minimum = 2e38 on a u8 alias no longer admits 255); component names that look like data keywords (default, example, enum) are namespaced in parameters, requestBodies, headers, callbacks, links, pathItems and webhooks; a #[path] module declared under src/ is scanned for cron jobs even when it loads a file outside src/; f32-suffixed float literals in defaults keep f32 precision and shortest decimal form; a Cargo.toml workspace declared as a dotted or quoted top-level key is detected. The rust-jni-demo standalone server binds 127.0.0.1 only. The compile-bench runner drops a sample whose cache or clean step failed.
